sentences.en: Too many irons in the fire result in bad workmanship.
sentences.zh: 太多在做的项目会导致工作质量差。

sentences.en: Iron the inside of collars first, and then the outside.
sentences.zh: 先熨衬衫领子里面，然后再熨外面。

sentences.en: I'm hopeless at ironing so I buy permanent press clothes.
sentences.zh: 我熨衣服的技术太差，所以我买免烫的衣服。

senses.zh: 铁，烙铁，熨斗，坚强，(复数)铁制物
